$comment: Per-environment runtime config, written to site-config.json by tools/scripts/prepare-hosting.mjs --site-config. Development uses Cloudflare's public always-pass Turnstile test key. null disables a feature's live path (the contact form falls back to email, the Orbit lab to its bundled snapshot). n8nUrl is the self-hosted n8n for StudyLM and ChatPulse; production takes it from the N8N_URL environment variable (a CI secret), so the tunnel address stays out of the repository.
